## Activity

During November 2020, Market Eye Clinic recorded 292 captures. This report summarises the activity completed at the site during the month and provides the corresponding image-quality and grading outcomes. The capture total is the basis for the review of image usability and the number of results requiring referral. No additional activity figures are included in this report.

## Image quality

Of the 292 captures, 19 were assessed as ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 6.5%. The finding indicates that most captures were available for assessment, while a smaller proportion could not be graded from the images provided. The ungradable total and rate are reported together to support review of image-quality performance for Market Eye Clinic during November 2020.

## Grading

A total of 46 results were recorded as referable. The median grading lag was 1 day. This measure describes the central turnaround for grading during the reporting period, while the referable total identifies the results requiring referral. Together, these figures provide a concise view of grading activity associated with the 292 captures received from Market Eye Clinic in November 2020.
